objectives_fil: Bumuo ng pahayag ng isyu na may iniulat na ebidensiya, pananaw ng apektadong residente at tanong na kailangan pang linawin.
Bumuo ng invitation plan na may apektadong grupo, pinagkakatiwalaang tagapag-imbita, hadlang at napagkasunduang paraan ng pakikilahok.
Pangasiwaan ang maikling pulong na may pagkakataong mag-ambag at kusang pinagkasunduang tungkulin ng pangunahing grupo.
Bumuo ng action plan na may responsable, kumpirmadong resources, petsa, follow-up at panukat na susuriin kasama ang residente.
objectives_en: Write an issue statement with reported evidence, affected residents’ perspectives and a question still to clarify.
Build an invitation plan identifying affected groups, trusted inviters, barriers and agreed participation options.
Facilitate a short meeting that invites contributions and agrees voluntary responsibilities for a core group.
Create an action plan with an owner, confirmed resources, dates, follow-up and a measure to review with residents.
summary_fil: Tukuyin, makinig, magplano at suriin kasama ang komunidad.
summary_en: Identify, listen, plan and review with the community.
